_comment: Glass opacity presets (item_139): the ONE table for surface alpha. Read by Commons/Appearance.qml (panel/card fills), scripts/theme-switch.py (kitty background_opacity + mango focused/unfocused window opacity = winFocused/winUnfocused) and scripts/contrast-check.py --glass (text contrast over a mid-grey wallpaper at each preset). panel = frame/panel glass, panelAlt = its lighter twin + sheen stops, card = dashboard/settings cards. glass is the pre-item_139 look (light panels raised 0.92/0.90 -> 0.96/0.95 so text stays AA over a mid-grey wallpaper) and the default. Two presets by owner decision 2026-09-30 (a third, more transparent step was dropped; the base look was renamed soft -> glass 2026-10-01). kitty is opaque in mango (windowrule, dotfiles), so its own kitty value carries the whole look: 0.5/0.77 = the old 0.6/0.9 x mango's 0.85. Light panels cannot go below ~0.94 without dropping gruvbox-light text under AA over mid-grey; dark stops at ~0.82 (monochrome). A pack material flat/matte stays opaque whatever the preset. blur (item_116, adr_035): the compositor blurs what is behind the shell's surfaces (theme-switch writes mango blur_layer; off with a pack); dark glass panels went 0.96/0.93 -> 0.85/0.82 so the blur shows, the lowest monochrome keeps AA at.
